metadata.title: Generic diagnostic experience
metadata.summary: Diagnose a stopped industrial machine through progressive evidence.

scenario.initial_context: A material handling machine has stopped during production.
scenario.operational_state: The machine is stationary in a controlled state.

safety_context.safe_state: No hazardous movement is permitted before authorization.
intervention_constraints: Preserve evidence before changing machine state.

decisions.action: Validate recovery and complete the experience.

visual.educational_purpose: Show the observable difference between the stopped state and controlled recovery.
